title: A one-file merge trial records the fast static rule tests among its selected tests
description: Runs a real loop cycle against a temporary Postgres control plane and scratch Git remote using scripts/ci-tests.mjs affected: a one-file change to an unrelated source file merges and its recorded merge.trial event lists all six static rule test files (architecture, architecture-pinned, barrel-imports, import-cycles, no-old-name, knip-clean) among its selected tests.

steps.name: Run a one-file merge trial on a test install and check its recorded selected tests
